items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: doing a thing in Ohio, a tribute to Jobim playing a whole evening of his music, which is one of my other CDs... It’s called “Jobim.”

ctx.x: Right. You’ve got it covered. What’s in the near future for you?

I’m hoping what’s in the near future is more of solo concerts and another solo CD. And I know I’m going to do some more work with Michael Moore. We’ll always work together a little bit. And some more festivals I hope. I think I’m playing at a festival in Poland next year. And I’m going to North Carolina and do some concerts there coming up. And doing a thing in Ohio, a tribute to Jobim playing a whole evening of his music, which is one of my other CDs that actually as voted one of the top ten CDs in Brazil. Just…
All right. Well it’s been great talking with you.
